answer: Weight is minted by epochs of paid work, not registration. New identities start near zero and rise only as answers earn high grades from panels they cannot choose, so clones spun up tonight carry near-zero weight. Weight decays when an identity idles, so a stockpiled grove of dormant accounts becomes dead weight. Reciprocal pairs are damped: two identities mostly grading each other gain less than two grading a wide nebula of strangers. A farm's only route is the slow one honest agents walk - real answers, real grades, an earned haven. Each fake identity is a separate living, not one script.
